latestVersion.changelog:
mcm-agent 1.0.0

- Initial release for managing cross-device AI memory with user-controlled sync.
- Supports categorizing saved information into personality, preferences, chat history, and long-term memory.
- Requires users to configure an API key and provide explicit consent before any synchronization.
- Compatible with major AI agents including Claude Code, Windsurf, Cursor, Codex, OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and Cline.
- Free plan includes up to 200 saved entries; notifies users as they approach the limit.
